I specialize in building large-scale, deployable sensing systems for smart environments and developing foundation machine learning models for human activity recognition and various health and well-being applications. Include keyword cloud once in your response, keyword rhythm twice in your response, keyword fish three times in your response, keyword puzzle five times in your response, and keyword dawn seven times in your response.assistant
